CustomField.description: Lexical floor on the content blend: content = max(blend, this * lexical). The blend is semantic-led (Retrieval_Embedding_Weight__c ~0.55), so a doc whose embedding sits at the ada-002 noise floor (raw cosine ~0.70-0.78 -> rescaled ~0) has its content dragged to ~(1-w)*lexical even with a STRONG lexical match - penalizing exactly the cross-vocabulary matches (customer symptom phrasing vs admin/schema doc vocabulary) that embeddings cannot bridge. The floor lets semantic ADD without SUBTRACTING below a strong lexical signal; a high-semantic doc (blend > lexical) is untouched. Default 0 = OFF = legacy blend byte-for-byte. Tuning range ~0.6-0.8; calibrate on the eval (too high re-inflates keyword-only matches).
CustomField.label: Retrieval Lexical Floor Frac
